extracted.name: Vegetarian chilli con carne
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by Good Food member Harrysu and has not been tested by our team.
ingredient_lines: 1 x 400g tin of baked beans or kidney beans/mixed beans
2tsp chilli powder more if you like it hot
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a frying pan and add chopped onions and peppers, fry until soft.
Add mince, continue cooking until brown, 2 - 3 minutes.
Add tomatoes, baked beans, tomato puree, stock cube, garlic, chilli, cumin powder and salt, cook on a low heat for 20 minutes, stir occasionally.
While chilli is cooking begin to cook rice.
Taste to see if more chilli is needed, if so cook for a further 2 minutes.
Serve hot with rice and tortilla chips.
